holderQuote: Her hands blurred. Ken saw the scalpel she was holding disappear in her left hand, and then Geneva was cutting deep, deep into the War Walker.

It blinked. The other potions exploded around it. Coating the Wyvern Lord with…liquid? Grimalkin, rising, saw Saliss duck back as the Wyvern Lord whirled, the [Alchemist] leaping out of the way of a breath of frost.
effectQuote: The [Alchemist] threw potions, his hands blurring as he moved.
